description: This file contains HTTP handlers for executing reasoners and skills within a workflow management system. It includes logic for processing requests, validating node existence, creating execution records, making HTTP calls to agent nodes, handling responses, and persisting execution states.

methods.name: ExecuteReasonerHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler function that processes requests to execute a reasoner, manages workflow execution state, and communicates with agent nodes.

methods.name: ExecuteSkillHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler function that processes requests to execute a skill on an agent node, managing execution lifecycle and response handling.
